title: Nebula I — Emergence
medium: Archival pigment print on 100% cotton rag
story: Emergence explores the moment order begins to surface from repetition. Curved geometric fields accumulate, echo and shift until the system feels almost alive — suspended between code, rhythm and perception.

title: Nebula II — Convergence
medium: Archival pigment print on 100% cotton rag
story: Convergence studies attraction, repetition and shared direction. Warm metallic forms gather around luminous points, creating a field that feels architectural from a distance and intricate at close range.
